title: Finite-submodule case of the fraction-field quotient length bound
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] local integral domain of Krull dimension one [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring], with fraction field $K$. Let $r\ge0$ and let $M\subseteq K^r$ be an $R$-submodule spanned by finitely many vectors. For any $0\ne x\in R$, $\operatorname{length}_R(M/xM)\le r\operatorname{length}_R(R/xR)$ [def-weil-pbc-module-length].

source.place: Algebra, Tag 00PE (lemma-finite-length), finite-case paragraph; two-short-exact-sequence refinement of its finite-cokernel argument, with Tag 00IV (lemma-length-additive)

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-fg-fraction-submodule-lattice-presentation] to obtain s≤r, N⊆F=R^s, d≠0, dF⊆N and M≅N. For d, [lem-weil-pbc-dim-le-one-principal-quotient-finite-length] gives length(R/dR)<∞. Coordinate quotientPi and length_pi_of_fintype give length(F/dF)=s length(R/dR). The surjection F/dF→F/N bounds length(F/N) by this finite quantity.

Multiplication by x is injective on F since R is a domain and x≠0. Define A=xN and T=xF. The map F/N→F/A induced by multiplication by x is injective because μ^{-1}(A)=N, and its image is the kernel of F/A→F/T. The map N/xN→F/A induced by inclusion is injective because A pulls back to xN inside N, and its image is the kernel of F/A→F/N. The quotient projections are surjective. Additivity [lem-weil-pbc-length-additive-short-exact] applied to these two sequences gives length(F/N)+length(F/xF)=length(N/xN)+length(F/N). Cancel the finite summand length(F/N), using ENat.add_left_injective_of_ne_top.
Coordinatewise quotientPi identifies F/xF with (R/xR)^s. Its length is s length(R/xR), by Module.length_pi_of_fintype. Transport along QuotSMulTop.congr for M≅N, and use s≤r to get the bound.
